review_scope: Complete Chinese–English alignment reading, including title and deck. Existing full English retained with seven localized corrections, pending independent correction review.

changes.before: One line from Sunzi's Art of War has been quoted for twenty-three centuries:
changes.after: One line from the "Attack by Stratagem" chapter of Sunzi's Art of War has been quoted for more than two thousand years:
changes.reason: Restore the specified 谋攻篇 chapter and avoid adding the unsupported precise twenty-three centuries to 两千多年.

changes.before: The medieval universities turned this into an institution. Aquinas structured the Summa so that each question first states the objections against his own position in their strongest form, and only then answers them. He was not looking for the weakest opponent; he was looking for the strongest. Public disputatio worked the same way — a thesis was attacked in the open, and the respondent had to meet every objection live. The aim of that kind of attack is not to destroy the other's argument. It is to force both positions into clarity.
changes.after: The medieval universities turned this into an institution. Aquinas structured the Summa so that each question first states the objections against his own position in their strongest form, and only then answers them. He was not looking for the weakest opponent; he was looking for the strongest. Public disputatio worked the same way — a thesis was attacked in the open, and the person presiding had to answer every objection on the spot. The aim of that kind of attack is not to destroy the other's argument. It is to force both positions into clarity.
changes.reason: 主持者 is the person presiding, not simply the respondent; preserve the role identified by the source.

changes.before: I have no historical example for this rung. That absence follows from its own definition: a mode of existence that does not require being seen leaves no identifiable trace in the record. Any example that can be produced probably belongs to a lower rung. The gap is not missing evidence. It is the nature of the level.
changes.after: I have no historical example for this rung. That absence follows from its own definition: a mode of existence that does not require being seen leaves no identifiable trace in the record. Any example that can be produced is probably not yet at this level. The gap is not missing evidence. It is the nature of the level.
changes.reason: 还不在这一级 does not explicitly rank every possible example on a lower rung; preserve the source qualification.

changes.before: The five are the different ways cultivation unfolds inside a collision. War is what repairs cultivation after it has been broken. It is not some honorable slot on the sequence; it sits outside it, a backstop invoked only because cultivation needs a route back.
changes.after: The five are the different ways cultivation unfolds inside a collision. War is a means of repairing cultivation after it has been broken. It is not some honorable slot on the sequence; it sits outside it, a backstop invoked only because cultivation needs a route back.
changes.reason: 修复手段 identifies a means, not a guarantee that war repairs cultivation.

changes.before: On the other side, a subject that genuinely operates by treating persons as ends has no necessity of expansion. Its purpose is that every subject exist as an end — and structurally that cannot be achieved by suppressing others. The opposite: suppressing others violates it directly, since the one suppressed is also a subject. It grows where it stands, and does not need expansion to sustain itself.
changes.after: On the other side, a subject that genuinely operates by treating persons as ends has no necessity of expansion. Its purpose is that every subject exist as an end — and structurally, achieving this does not require suppressing others. The opposite: suppressing others violates it directly, since the one suppressed is also a subject. It grows where it stands, and does not need expansion to sustain itself.
changes.reason: 不需要 is lack of necessity, not impossibility; the subsequent sentence separately supplies the incompatibility.

changes.before: The four theorems, the three ending forms, and the standard against self-annihilation — none of these exist only to restrain the attacker. They exist just as much to keep the resisting side from sliding into the structure it set out to resist.
changes.after: The four theorems, the three ending forms, and the standard against self-annihilation — none of these exist only to restrain the attacker. More importantly, they exist to keep the resisting side from sliding into the structure it set out to resist.
changes.reason: 更是 emphasizes the self-constraint rather than giving both uses merely equal weight.

changes.before: The answer is more counterintuitive than it sounds. It is not winning.
changes.after: The answer is more counterintuitive than you might expect. It is not winning.
changes.reason: 比想象中 refers to expectation, not to how an answer sounds.
